item.title: ‘The stories we choose to preserve will shape the kind of society we become’
item.description: 'We find ourselves in a moment when truth is challenged, minimized, or reframed for comfort rather than clarity.'

item.title: Bucolic beauty, a way of life, local history: what the proposed motocross track would destroy
item.description: Letter: The proposed 4,000-foot motocross track will bring an incredible amount of traffic, air pollution, light pollution and noise to the area, and will change the surrounding areas forever.

item.title: Linda M. Bilski-Copenhaver, 78
item.description: Linda M. Bilski-Copenhaver of Riverhead died Feb. 26, 2026, at Kanas Center for Hospice Care in Quiogue. She was 78 years old.

item.title: The ‘I BIRD NY’ challenge begins March 1
item.description: The DEC's annual “I BIRD NY Challenge” asks birders of all ages and experience levels to identify 10 wild bird species anywhere in New York State.

item.title: America’s Boating Course to be offered at Riverhead library this spring
item.description: The United States Power Squadrons will present “America’s Boating Course” beginning Saturday, April 25 at the Riverhead Free Library.

item.title: East End Food Hub to reopen event space this month, marking major milestone
item.description: After years of planning, fundraising and construction, East End Food will welcome the public back to its Riverhead hub in March.

item.title: ‘ICE Out’ vigil and march take place in Riverhead after operations by masked agents Friday
item.description: After masked federal agents were active around Riverhead Friday, residents gathered for an “ICE Out” vigil, protest and march downtown this weekend.

item.title: Hilkka M. Torronen, 98
item.description: Hilkka M. Torronen of Mattituck died Feb. 23, 2026, at home. She was 98 years old.

item.title: Anita Lucille Fagan, 82
item.description: Anita Lucille Fagan of Southold died March 1, 2026, at home. She was 82 years old.

item.title: Pulaski Street snow removal Tuesday morning
item.description: Riverhead Highway Superintendent Mike Zaleski said highway crews will be removing snow piles from Pulaski Street in Polish Town Tuesday morning, beginning at 7 a.m.
